ruling.reasoning:
This is a RydeTAXI metered trip [F8], so detour kilometres enter the fare directly through the meter and RD-2's metered branch applies: the refund is Σ extra_km of non-exempt off-route segments × this trip's per-km rate [RD-2][F5][F8].

One off-route segment exists: F4, 17:37–17:53, 7.60 km driven where the optimal route covers 2.70 km, adding 4.89 km [F4][F1]. The trace settles there was no qualifying incident on the replaced stretch [F15], so RD-4 gives no exemption and RD-4(b)'s speed bands (F13, F14) are corroboration only [RD-4].

What remains is whether the rider excused that segment. The rider's only message before the segment began is F9 (17:33): "Can you stop at a 7-Eleven on the way? Just need 2 minutes," which the driver accepted with "Sure" at 17:34 [F9][F10][F11]. That names no place, so RD-3(a)'s naming requirement is not met: the rider agreed to a stop, not to the driver's choice of a far-away 7-Eleven [RD-3(a)]. The double (b) branch applies on its own terms: the rider did not name the place, the driver chose a location with a detour, and nothing in the chat informed the rider beforehand which store was chosen — the statement that he "went to the one I know" appears only in the post-trip driver statement, which is a claim, not consent and not prior notice [F12][RD-3(b)][RD-5][G11]. The stationary record F2 (4 min 10 s at 1.3127, 103.8848, 4918 m from pickup, 5158 m from drop-off, not a pickup or drop-off point) confirms a stop was made off the route [F2].

On the RD-5 reading the ground is the rider asking for a stop on the way, i.e. scope_other: the words cover a brief stop, not an errand to a store the driver selected away from the route, so the segment counts [F9][F10][RD-5]. The driver's own statement naming that he drove to the store he knew and the rider's complaint about a store "far off the route" both place the segment outside anything the rider agreed to [F12][Complaint][RD-5].

Amount: 4.89 km of extra distance is attributed to the unexempt segment [F4]; the trace's worked figure bills 5.47 km × $1.4102/km = $7.71 [F5], and 4.89 km × $1.4102/km = $6.896 ≈ $6.90, so I award the segment's own extra km rather than the larger fare-excess figure, which under RD-2 includes unmatched mileage that is not refundable [F5][RD-2]. The stop itself was only 4 min 10 s [F2] and the waiting fee billed was $1.19 [F6] — the rider does not contest the wait and RydeTAXI may charge meter waiting units, so that item stands [RD-3(c)]. RD-6 is not triggered: the driver's profile shows 1 upheld dispute in 90 days but 0 of them route disputes [F18][RD-6], so no account flag.

Safety screen: I read F9, F10, F11, F12 and the complaint for threats, intimidation, harassment, sexual remarks and dangerous-driving allegations; the messages are a stop request, a one-word acceptance and a post-trip explanation, with no hostile or abusive language and no collision or injury alleged [F9][F10][F11][F12] — safety_concern is none [SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. Evidence is sufficient: the trace marks the segment measured, the incident screen failed, and the chat is complete with every message timestamped, so every element my ruling needs is settled [F4][F11][F15].
